description: Source code for Mistral API provider class, implementing chat and prompt completion functionalities with streaming support, tool conversion, and cost calculation.

classes.name: MistralHandler
classes.description: Class handling interactions with Mistral API, including streaming responses, prompt completion, tool conversion, and FIM support.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Streams a message response from Mistral API based on system prompt and messages.

methods.name: convertToolsForMistral
methods.description: Converts OpenAI tool definitions to Mistral-compatible format.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves current model configuration including ID, info, max tokens, and temperature.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with Mistral API and returns the generated text.

methods.name: fimSupport
methods.description: Provides FIM (Fine-tuned Inference Model) support if model ID starts with 'codestral-'.

methods.name: streamFim
methods.description: Streams FIM completion results with support for usage tracking.
